Balanced Figure7C Gaussian unit-intercept REML coefficient/variance reconstruction

figure7c_four_method.family: Gaussian linear mixed model on transformed response
figure7c_four_method.random_effect: unit-specific random intercept; iid residual term

covariates.alpha_s: sample-standardized lv; alpha_s is only the R variable name, not synthetic Hawkes excitation strength

figure7c_four_method.reconstruction_scope: conditional on exact admitted balanced four-method table; coefficients and variance components can be reconstructed without claiming source p-values/profile intervals/native parity

figure7c_trial_pseudoerror.family: Gaussian linear mixed model on transformed response
figure7c_trial_pseudoerror.random_effect: unit-specific random intercept; iid residual term
figure7c_trial_pseudoerror.zero_error: log10(0) is negative infinity; source does not specify an epsilon, arbitrary offset or special deletion policy. Refuse the affected model with an explicit reason rather than silently modifying the estimand.
figure7c_trial_pseudoerror.commented_filter: The fr_hz_spont_30min<=10 filter at line17 is commented out; it is not the admitted model filter.

source_scaling.mean: arithmetic mean across rows of the model table
source_scaling.sd: sqrt(sum((x-mean)^2)/(N-1)) across model-table rows, excluding NA only as the R function does; admitted table should already be finite
source_scaling.duplication: Each unit occurs four times for four-method fit and twice for trial-only fit. Repeated rows count in N and the sum. Scaling unique-unit covariates first gives a different ddof correction and is not exact source scaling.
source_scaling.zero_or_nonfinite_sd: Cannot produce valid standardized design; explicit refusal is a defensible numerical admission rule, not a biological filter.
source_scaling.scope_note: This is retrospective source-model scaling; it is not a train-only preprocessing policy for an independent prospective evaluation.

source_table_construction.tau_scale: notebook tau in lag bins multiplied by50 to obtain ms
source_table_construction.trial_replicate: get_trials_plot_df uses taus[0] and acf[0]. It creates seeded random indices but never selects them.
common_mask: Build method rows with unit,tau,tau_ms,fit_r_squared,decline flag,area,FR,Lv.
Remove every unit having any NaN in any of the four method rows.
Remove every unit having negative fit_r_squared in any of the four method rows.
Fit models on this common unit support. R² exactly0 is retained. Decline flag is carried but no decline-based filtering is applied here.
Compute logarithms only after common mask. No fit-CI-excludes-zero filter is applied in the table constructor.
source_table_construction.important_boundary: Source masks NaN; implementations may reject nonfinite supplied metadata instead of extrapolating infinity semantics. Never silently reduce common support separately per method.

duration_trial_source_semantics.population: Begin with the admitted complete 5,775-unit/26-mouse empirical roster. Counts do not establish authentic identities. Sensitivity complete-case subsets differ from the 3,053 Figure 7C subset.
duration_trial_source_semantics.duration_selection: First D minutes, half-open prefix [0, D*60*fs), with fs=30000. Preserve the same unit identity across all levels and both methods.
duration_trial_source_semantics.trial_sampling: get_trials calls Python randrange(0, signal_len-trial_len+1) for every start. Replacement and overlap are permitted; extraction is half-open and each trial clock resets to its start. No historical seed or required nested relation between count conditions was found. Analysis selects the first saved iteration for each unit.
duration_trial_source_semantics.fit_scale: tau_ms=50*tau_bins. fit_single_exp starts at index 1. Full-recording curves have 21 points; trial curves have 20. Preserve every failed coordinate. The 30-minute fits serve as references; R duration analysis excludes them from predictor rows.
duration_trial_source_semantics.comparison_support: Figure 7D/F captions require common units with estimates for both methods at all four levels within the respective panel. The notebooks do not reliably implement this caption. Source fidelity and corrected support therefore need separately named policies. No active negative-R-squared cutoff appears in either sensitivity notebook; the trial cutoff is commented out. Do not inherit Figure 7C filtering silently.
duration_trial_source_semantics.display_metrics: Pseudo-REE is 100*abs(tau_short-tau_reference)/tau_reference. Full-recording fits are pseudo references, not biological truth. Percentages use inclusive thresholds 100,75,50,25 and the admitted common-case unit denominator. Zero error gives nonfinite log10 response; do not add an arbitrary epsilon. Undefined denominators or log support must remain explicit.
duration_trial_source_semantics.grouping: Notebook percentages weight units. Figure 7D/F source models use repeated-unit random intercepts, not mouse random effects. Units must not be described as independent animals. Any mouse-cluster uncertainty or equal-mouse estimand is a named prospective extension, not historical replay.
duration_trial_source_semantics.area_scope: Area sensitivity notebooks are distinct: pooled area ACF matrices are fit with fit_single_exp_2d beginning at lag 2. They are not summaries of unit-level taus and do not supply animal-level inference.

documented_source_conflicts.paper_methods: Section 4.8 names ACF/iSTTC references for PearsonR/iSTTC trials respectively; its length/count sentence names the full signal without a method.
documented_source_conflicts.duration_notebook: Cells 15/16 use ACF30 for ACF and iSTTC30 for iSTTC.
documented_source_conflicts.trial_notebook: Cell 13 uses ACF30 for PearsonR at every count. Cell 14 uses ACF30 for iSTTC40 and iSTTC30 for iSTTC60/80/100.

documented_source_conflicts.finding: Both 100-trial log-error columns are assigned log10 of 40-trial errors, although raw 100-trial errors were computed separately.
documented_source_conflicts.implication: Recomputing the correct 100-trial log error is a documented repair, not exact replay of CSV generation.

documented_source_conflicts.finding: Cell 11 references pearsontr_trial_acf_*_df names, while active loading cells create pearsontr_*_df, and references 150/200-trial variables absent from the active grid. Saved execution order and namespace cannot be assumed.

remove_nans removes unit IDs with any NaN in the ACF1 dataframe; iSTTC NaNs are counted but not used. Cell 19 then recomputes NaNs after filtering, and cell 20 propagates that possibly empty set to other levels. No reliable common all-level mask appears.

Retains units with non-null tau_ms at every observed method/count combination. required_combos comes from observed data rather than a fixed count of eight. R-squared and upper-tau filters are commented out. Reference and log availability are not validated.
Reference arithmetic aligns pandas indexes rather than joining explicit unit IDs. Authenticate source file row order or document the stronger ID-based contract of the new implementation.

Full iSTTC driver defaults use 1,501-tick lag and 1,500-tick tolerance rather than the paper settings 1,500/750. Other active defaults include 100 trials and items_to_process=2000. The generator notebook uses 200 trials and range(3). These defaults do not establish full paper production.
No historical random seed/state, window-object identity or cross-count nested selection policy is established. Fixed prospective windows cannot be called recovered historical samples.

Author LMMs inspected by the parallel GLM reviewer use unit random intercepts. No animal-level cluster inference is pinned here. Authentic mouse/session IDs and a declared animal-grouped protocol remain necessary.
